LingoSpark — single classroom licence

You may:
- Use these files with your own students (one teacher, one school class / one tutoring group).
- Print copies for those students.
- Paste the lists into LingoSpark games for those students.

You may not:
- Share, upload, or resell the paste files, PDFs, or HTML (Google Drive “for the whole school”, Librus, Facebook groups, TPT as your own, etc.).
- Add these lists to a public website or a free download dump.
- Claim the lists as the free demo sets on lingospark.study (those are a different topic: Człowiek).

A second teacher needs their own copy.

Questions: karolsenk@gmail.com
